visual_identity.description: Brand-specific visual system such as typography, palette references, layout, imagery, iconography, motion, and logo-use rules.

content_style.description: Brand-specific editorial/content preferences such as tone, sentence style, pacing, formatting, storytelling, CTA style, and modality preferences.

channel_preferences.description: Channel-specific expression preferences and constraints that override generic defaults when appropriate.

reference_assets.description: References to approved examples, templates, or Assets that demonstrate desired brand expression.

prohibited_styles.description: Explicit styles, patterns, language, visuals, or behaviors the brand does not want used.

brand_rules.description: Other durable brand-specific expression or presentation rules. Reusable business claims, promises, claim constraints, and claim prohibitions belong in BusinessClaim rather than Brand.
